name: Pirih Rubik's Competition 2014

venue.name: Pirih Boxing Camp
venue.details: The venue is a Boxing Camp in Surabaya, East Java. Most people In Surabaya know this place.

information: This is a simple competition for maximum about 20 competitors only. The registration fee is IDR 50.000 for all events (on the spot). For more information, you can contact Cendy (+6283869962288).
